headline: Cloud & Security Engineer
summary: Cloud and security engineer with 6 years of experience running identity, infrastructure and automation for companies of 300–2,000 employees. Cut incident response time by 40% by building a SIEM pipeline and on-call runbooks, and moved 120 workloads to AWS with zero unplanned downtime. Comfortable between hands-on engineering and explaining risk to management.

bullets.text: Migrated 120 workloads from on-premise VMware to AWS (EC2, RDS, ECS) with zero unplanned downtime.
Built a SIEM pipeline in Microsoft Sentinel with 45 detection rules, cutting mean time to respond by 40%.
Rolled out Entra ID conditional access and MFA to 1,800 users, reaching 99% enrolment in 6 weeks.
Automated account provisioning with PowerShell and Terraform, saving the service desk ~20 hours per month.
Led the ISO 27001 technical controls workstream and passed the certification audit with no major findings.
Administered 60 Windows and Linux servers and a 12-site network (Fortigate, Cisco).
Introduced backup testing and a disaster-recovery plan; restored a ransomware-hit file server in 3 hours.
Replaced ad-hoc email requests with a ServiceNow catalogue handling ~400 tickets per month.
Supported 250 users across 4 hotels; wrote the onboarding guide still used by the IT team.
Proxmox cluster with Tailscale, Authentik SSO and Grafana monitoring; documented on GitHub.

certifications: Microsoft SC-300 Identity and Access Administrator (2022)
